title: IPSO Direct CoAP resource handlers
description:
Add IPSO Direct resource handling to CoAP server in python/src/lichen/coap/

- Register /{object}/{instance}/{resource} URI pattern
- GET: read sensor value, return Content-Format 60 (CBOR)
- PUT: write actuator value from CBOR payload
- Discovery: add rt=ipso to /.well-known/core
- Wire up to existing sensor/actuator abstractions

Depends on: IPSO Direct codec (worker6-rhkq)
Reference: spec/07-transport-app.md section 10.2.2
